description: Java class 'IntellijLintRequest' extending 'LintRequest' that manages lint analysis requests within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment, including project and module handling, scope inference, and incremental analysis support.

classes.name: IntellijLintRequest
classes.description: A class representing a lint request in IntelliJ IDEA, managing project scope, modules, and incremental analysis.

methods.name: IntellijLintRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lint request with client, project, files, modules, and incremental flag.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Determines and returns the scope of the lint analysis, adjusting for class file support.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Returns the collection of projects to be analyzed, creating single-file or module-based projects as needed.
